item.title: Labour 'wants any excuse for censorship' says Elon Musk amid Ofcom probe into his X platform
item.description: Elon Musk has accused Labour of wanting "any excuse for censorship" as an Ofcom probe into his X social media platform continues.His website faces the threat of being shut down over AI-generated pornography and child abuse images.The platform has an AI chatbot called Grok which can create sexual images of people, including children, at users' request.But other AI platforms like ChatGPT are able to do the same thing - and have not fallen victim to an Ofcom probe.
